## Checklist

- [ ] User-facing text and documentation are in English.
- [ ] No credentials, serial numbers or machine-specific paths are included.
- [ ] `make -C gtk4 check` passes when GTK4 code is affected.
- [ ] Hardware-control changes were tested at a safe monitoring level.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior changed.
